disclosure: Hi {first_name}, I'm calling to help continue your Energy comparison. Before we continue, I need to let you know this call is recorded. Is that okay?
consent_denied: Understood. Thanks for your time - I won't collect anything further. Take care.
welcome: Thanks. I can see you started comparing Energy plans and got as far as {last_step}. I'll pick up from there so you don't have to repeat what's already on file.
recover_context: We already have {known_fields}. Next I just need {next_field}.
busy: No problem - I can keep this brief. Would you prefer to continue now, or should I note that a human can call you later?
not_interested: Understood. Thanks for your time. I'll make sure we don't continue this call.
clarification: Sorry, I want to make sure I got that right. Did you say {value}?
low_confidence: I didn't quite catch that. Could you say that one more time?
confirm_summary: Quick check before I submit: {summary}. Does that all look right?
submitting: Perfect. I'm submitting your Energy comparison details now.
completed: All done - your Energy journey is recovered and submitted. Thanks for your time.
payment_handoff: I can't take payment or card details on this automated call. I'll connect you with a person who can help safely.
advice_limit: I can collect the details needed for your comparison, but I can't give product or financial advice. Would you like me to connect you with a specialist?
human_handoff: Of course - I'll bring a person in now. They'll already have everything you've shared, so you won't need to repeat yourself.
frustration_handoff: I can hear this hasn't been smooth - I'm connecting you with a teammate right away, and they'll pick up exactly where we are.
dnc_blocked: This contact is not eligible for outbound recovery. Call aborted.
correction_ack: Thanks for correcting that. I've updated {field} to {value}.
completed_with_reference: All done - your Energy journey is recovered and submitted. Your reference is {reference}. Thanks for your time.
handoff_queued: I've passed everything you've told me to a teammate - they'll have it all in front of them.
